description: This Java class represents a request object for autocomplete functionality in a web shop. It constructs JSON strings for autocomplete queries and provides methods to get collection names based on merchant and language codes.

classes.name: AutoCompleteRequest
classes.description: A class representing an autocomplete request, capable of generating JSON query strings for autocomplete search endpoints, and managing merchant and language codes.

methods.name: AutoCompleteRequest
methods.description: Constructor initializing merchant and language codes.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Generates a JSON string for an autocomplete query based on the input term.

methods.name: getCollectionName
methods.description: Constructs and returns the collection name string based on language and merchant codes.
